decisions.reason: As a close extension of our upholstery range, its continued website presence in 2024 suggests enough market traction for us to use our existing design and R&D knowledge to refine rather than abandon it.

Because this decorative fabric is highly related to our established competencies and remained in the collection across both years, we would keep it and build on what we can learn from customer response.

Its sustained standalone presentation and functional flame-retardant feature fit our strong interior-textile knowledge base, making it a product where our absorptive capacity and in-house R&D can be applied effectively.
This product builds directly on our established decoration-fabric capabilities, and its continued listing indicates a viable place in our broad range that can be improved through ongoing learning.
As a related development within our semi-transparent and textured fabric expertise, its persistence on the website supports keeping it while leveraging our existing knowledge to optimize the offer.
Since it is a recent launch with its own page and strong overlap with our upholstery and curtain know-how, we would keep it to allow more time for market learning and commercial application.
